notes.title: Kickstarter Update (Fully Funded!)
notes.notes:
Kickstarter! FULLY FUNDED! 

Stretch goals achieved: Extra Art + NSFW! 

Next up: Voice Acting, followed by the Fourth Love Interest.


If you saw our last news update or follow us on social you'll have seen that we have a Kickstarter running to get out game funded. 

We've met several goals already but there's still a lot to go! 

To bring our game to you and to be the best it can be we need funding. 


We have several updates and special reveals up on twitter, discord, patreon and kickstarter for teaser art and updates, including a nsfw preview with our fourth love interest and a bust sketch of his design! 

We've also unlocked several social goals including a give away and nsfw art poll to be held on twitter when the campaign ends. 


Stretch Goals

We're working on our 3rd stretch goal Voice Acting 


If you havent played our demo yet, check out a voice preview of our talented cast below! 


[previewyoutube=CeypajdSUwQ;full][/previewyoutube]


With the voice talents of Edward A. Mendoza, Patrick Mealey, June Yoon and many others our demo showcases the robust talent of the indie community and we hope and aim to be able to bring these voices to you for the entire game with FULL voice acting. 


If you'd like to help us reach our goals you can back us here: The Inn Between: A BL / BxB Visual Novel
